objectives: At the end of the course, students will be able to speak, write, and comprehend Zulu at a more intense level than in Elementary Zulu I.
At the end of the course, students will be able to initiate and maintain conversations beyond simple questions and answers as well as write clear thoughts in the Zulu language.
topics: Noun categories Prepositions Questions and negation Adverbs and pronouns including personal, object, and possessive pron
